verdict.rationale: LocalAI advertises real-time speech-in/speech-out over WebRTC ('speech in, tool calls in the middle, speech out over WebRTC, fast enough to feel like a conversation') and general voice support, suggesting on-device transcription is possible, but there is no dedicated documentation of a dictation UX flow or real-time streaming transcription API details. missing for 10: dedicated STT/dictation feature docs, latency/streaming specifics, hands-on or independent verification of real-time transcription accuracy and on-device model usage.
